sources.title: Ableton pricing guide (third-party, used to corroborate list prices)

keyLimits.en: Entry edition with a reduced number of tracks, scenes, and included instruments/effects compared to Standard and Suite.
Unlimited tracks and scenes, full audio/MIDI editing, larger instrument and effect library than Intro.
Adds full instrument/sound-pack collection, Max for Live, and additional production tools not in Standard.

cautions.en: List prices confirmed via a third-party pricing guide (Live Intro $99, Standard $439, Suite $749); the official shop page did not render itemized prices in this session's fetch and should be re-verified before publication.
Ableton typically runs seasonal discounts (around Black Friday) of 20-25% off list price, per third-party sources; not confirmed on the official page.

capabilities.en: Digital audio workstation combining a linear arrangement view with a non-linear Session view for live performance and improvisation.
Built-in instruments, audio effects, and MIDI effects for music production and sound design.

limitations.en: Live Intro caps the number of tracks/scenes and included content, making it unsuitable for larger productions.
One-time license with no bundled cloud collaboration features comparable to some subscription-based competitors.

reason.en: Lower-cost DAW alternative with a comparable feature set for music production.
Not a direct DAW competitor but frequently paired or compared for AV production workflows.

missingAlternatives.name: FL Studio
missingAlternatives.reason: Major direct competitor DAW, especially popular for electronic music production, absent from the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.name: Logic Pro
missingAlternatives.reason: Leading macOS-only DAW competitor with a one-time price, not present in the catalogue.

unknowns: Official ableton.com shop page did not return itemized pricing in this session (fetch returned only a product title); prices were corroborated via a third-party comparison site and should be re-verified against ableton.com directly.
Exact discounted/upgrade pricing between editions was not confirmed.
